@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
set BACKUP_DIR=D:\backups\%date:~-4%%date:~4,2%%date:~7,2%
if not exist "%BACKUP_DIR%" mkdir "%BACKUP_DIR%"
xcopy /E /I /Y "C:\Data" "%BACKUP_DIR%" >nul
echo Backup complete: %BACKUP_DIR%
-----
@echo off
for /f "tokens=1,2 delims==" %%a in (settings.ini) do (
    if "%%a"=="port" set PORT=%%b
)
echo Starting server on port %PORT%
start "" "C:\Program Files\App\server.exe" --port %PORT%
-----
cmd /c "ipconfig /all > %TEMP%\net.txt && type %TEMP%\net.txt"
-----
@echo off
net stop spooler
del /Q /F %SystemRoot%\System32\spool\PRINTERS\*
net start spooler
echo Print spooler restarted
-----
if exist C:\Windows\Temp\*.tmp del /Q C:\Windows\Temp\*.tmp
robocopy C:\Source D:\Mirror /MIR /R:2 /W:5 /LOG:C:\Logs\mirror.log
-----
schtasks /create /tn "NightlyBackup" /tr "C:\Scripts\backup.bat" /sc daily /st 02:00
